datatables: All four My Day tables initialize with search, length and paging controls
Header sorting, negative/large money and refreshed dates sort by their actual values
Live refresh preserves each table search, sorting and current page without duplicate toolbars
Rows-per-page survives refresh and a shrinking result moves back to an available page
Empty/refilled results retain controls and show the correct empty message
An initially empty day initializes and receives its first live rows
Printable shift report stays a complete ordinary table
